properties.description: Every presented data beat matches the accepted input prefix in order, including zero padding, truncation and final-byte marking, independently of readiness. Unknown enabled observations do not pass.
Every presented status matches the next completed accepted frame, including original and adjusted lengths and both flags. Status consumption is independent of data consumption.
Blocked data and status channels retain valid and their complete payload until acceptance or reset.
After a synchronous reset edge both response valids are clear. Reset cancels queued and partial-frame obligations without clearing recorded violations.

Meaningful handshake observations and accepted bytes must be determinate; accepted frame lengths and private queue occupancy must remain within the bounded representation. This slot diagnoses observation or input-domain problems, not source-protocol compliance.

At final post, combinationally require no incomplete accepted frame, queued expected data or status, or remaining source or response valid. Completion is checked without another clock edge, under the supplied drained-tail evaluation contract.
